goal: Bind canonical GoalDrivenProjectPlan test intents to post-build goal acceptance without changing final-verdict authority.
acceptance_criteria: Each GoalDrivenProjectPlan assigns a stable exact test symbol to every acceptance behavior without changing the canonical GoalSpec truth.
Goal acceptance remains a support receipt and cannot authorize canonical final verdict, packaging, delivery receipt, or public delivery PASS.
Missing, trivial, mismatched, or failed goal tests produce NEEDS_REWORK and cannot be hidden by UI, fixture, packaging, or planning support artifacts.
Post-build goal acceptance independently verifies plan identity, substantive executable tests, and a real passing test result before candidate review readiness.
The existing Provider tests component receives and implements those exact goal-test symbols through its current manifest and leaf route.

quality_metrics.measure: formal provider and delivery route preservation
quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: existing kernel and formal provider test profiles

quality_metrics.measure: canonical goal behaviors mapped to substantive executable tests and a real passing post-build test run
quality_metrics.target: every canonical test intent has one exact non-trivial test symbol and the post-build goal-acceptance receipt is PASS before review readiness
quality_metrics.method: deterministic plan-identity inspection, Python test AST inspection, post-build test-result binding, and negative missing/trivial/failed-test cases

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.

control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.

feedback: Canonical goal behaviors now bind exact Provider-generated test symbols to substantive collected pytest tests and the current real test execution before review readiness.

worked: Reusing the existing tests manifest and post-build wrapper kept planning, execution, and delivery authority separated.
did_not_work: The first official quick run hit one existing Codex conversation asynchronous session-state race; the isolated test then passed three consecutive repetitions.
experiments: Keep exact goal-test identity in the plan and require collected-test plus source-hash evidence; defer any CGKNFinalVerdict consumption to its dedicated next increment.
